name: Vaurelith Conduit
text: Conduit node, tier 1. Set its channel with the tuner. Every node on that channel trades items, fluids and FE, in any dimension. Sneak with an empty hand to step a face: off, send, receive. Send pulls from the block beside it, receive pushes into it. Age VI.

name: Ordhevane Conduit
text: Conduit node, tier 2. Same as the tier 1 node with eight times the bandwidth per run. Age VII.

name: Sulmerith Cell
text: Fluid cell. A plain tank that every face can fill and empty, handy at the end of a conduit. Use it to read the contents. Age VI.

name: Kaldruvane Cell
text: Energy cell. A plain FE battery that every face can charge and drain, handy at the end of a conduit. Use it to read the contents. Age VI.

name: Thorvaneth Tuner
text: Tuner. Use it on a conduit node to put it on your channel 1, then again to step up one channel; sneak to step down. Only the node's owner can tune it. Others join your channel only if you run /diaithirconduits trust. Age VI.
